artboards.title: Need a day · pushed from Plan
v2 · What’s new as a row

annotations.text:
v1 · SHELL: Plan · Find · Ideas, and the bar.

Plan stays as it is. The Sort tab becomes one row at the top of Plan, “3 need a day”, that opens the Sort page (New, Snoozed, Someday; Overdue is already on Plan). Find is one field for two jobs: results as you type, and an Ask Peggy row that turns the query into a conversation. Search and Ask stop being overlays. The bar does Plan and Idea only; Ask leaves the pill. Ideas is unchanged.

Gone from the shell: the Sort tab, the Search sheet, the Ask sheet, Ask mode in the bar, the “N to sort” card (the row replaces it).

v2 · PRO ON THE NAV, NOTHING IN A POPUP
The middle tab is Peggy, not Find. Same field, two jobs: search is free and instant, asking is Pro. A free user sees example questions and the offer on the page itself; a Pro user gets matches and the answer under one field. Nothing opens as a sheet.

Where each overlay went:
• Suggestions sheet → off by default; when on, a single chip row above the bar.
• Ask sheet → the Peggy tab.
• Search sheet → the Peggy tab (free half).
• Improve sheet → a “Peggy suggests” block inside item detail.
• Tag picker → tag chips inline in the editor.
• Paywall sheet → a page with a back arrow, reached from the Peggy tab and Settings.
• What’s new dialog → one row on Plan that opens a page.
• Onboarding → the first-capture screen.
The bar keeps its chips row (it is the bar, not an overlay) and the Plan/Idea pill; the big toggle row goes.
